html:
Update13 November 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
📜Patch Notes - November 13, 2026
Freedich and Diamond Shores gold traders have been rebalanced, World Boss fights adjusted, and Hellforged gear made the new catch-up standard. Plus, new Kapirosian activities, housing rotation tickets, extra rewards, QoL improvements, and fixes!

Features:

  • Freedich and Diamond Shores gold traders have had their values adjusted
    • Freedich gold trader is now rewarding MORE gold than before, matching DS
    • DS now rewards less gold, matching Freedich before update
  • Freedich Gold Trader will now be up for 2 hours, rest for 2 hours and repeat!
  • Guild Flares no longer are usable in the Sunspeck Sea and on Freedich Island
  • The Altar of Hata in Swirling Meadows is now inhabited by the Kapirosian Communal Charity group. They are looking for adventurers interested in volunteering to improving Erenor.
  • Some World Bosses have been readjusted to change their fight durations
    • Kraken has +20% effective health
    • Beserker has +30% effective health
    • A spire has been removed from the last phase of Primal Anthalon
  • Primal Anthalon's Generals have been had their properties adjusted:
    • They are now affected by Taunt effects.
    • Their damage reduction has been lowered, allowing you to build aggro on them through damage more reliably.
    • Their regeneration has been greatly increased
    • Return distance has been increased
  • Hellforged is now the default "free gear type".
    • Soulforged > Hellforged conversion now only costs 1 activity token
    • The Catch-Up Items Kit now directly grants Hellforged equipment
  • Greater Bounty: Titan Musperosa (Greater Howling Abyss) now grants extra rewards
    • 1x Phoenix Ashes
    • 1x Superior Grinding Guardian Scroll
  • Housing Rotation Tickets have been added to the game, and will included in the marketplace in the near future.

Interface:

  • Options > AAC Misc. Settings: new Show crop growth timers checkbox (on by default).

Fixes:

  • Fixed trade pack storages sitting raised on the Farm Freighter, Red Farm Freighter and Pirate Freighter.
  • Restored the missing Auctioneer in Solzreed Peninsula. Thanks for the report Hiro.
  • Karkasse Dragon Jerky now expires in 96 hours instead of 144

== Features: ==
* Freedich and Diamond Shores gold traders have had their values adjusted
** Freedich gold trader is now rewarding MORE gold than before, matching DS
** DS now rewards less gold, matching Freedich before update
* Freedich Gold Trader will now be up for 2 hours, rest for 2 hours and repeat!
* Guild Flares no longer are usable in the Sunspeck Sea and on Freedich Island
* The Altar of Hata in Swirling Meadows is now inhabited by the Kapirosian Communal Charity group. They are looking for adventurers interested in volunteering to improving Erenor.
* Some World Bosses have been readjusted to change their fight durations
** Kraken has +20% effective health
** Beserker has +30% effective health
** A spire has been removed from the last phase of Primal Anthalon
* Primal Anthalon's Generals have been had their properties adjusted:
** They are now affected by Taunt effects.
** Their damage reduction has been lowered, allowing you to build aggro on them through damage more reliably.
** Their regeneration has been greatly increased
** Return distance has been increased
* Hellforged is now the default "free gear type".
** Soulforged > Hellforged conversion now only costs 1 activity token
** The Catch-Up Items Kit now directly grants Hellforged equipment
* Greater Bounty: Titan Musperosa (Greater Howling Abyss) now grants extra rewards
** 1x Phoenix Ashes
** 1x Superior Grinding Guardian Scroll
* Housing Rotation Tickets have been added to the game, and will included in the marketplace in the near future.

== Interface: ==
* Options > AAC Misc. Settings: new Show crop growth timers checkbox (on by default).

== Fixes: ==
* Fixed trade pack storages sitting raised on the Farm Freighter, Red Farm Freighter and Pirate Freighter.
* Restored the missing Auctioneer in Solzreed Peninsula. Thanks for the report Hiro.
* Karkasse Dragon Jerky now expires in 96 hours instead of 144
